title: Chase County Nebraska deputy sees 30-50 drones and mothership
summary: Merrick tells of Chase County Nebraska deputy sees 30-50 drones and mothership, about 2019-2020 at Chase County, Nebraska; Colorado, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Reports from Colorado indicate that drones were not flying as a group or pack, but as a single unit. Chase County, Nebraska sheriff deputy reported observing 30 to 50

plain: A guest on a podcast, Merrick, reads from reports about mysterious drones seen over Colorado and Nebraska in 2019 and 2020. According to those reports, the drones moved not as a loose pack but as a single unit, and a sheriff's deputy in Chase County, Nebraska, said he watched 30 to 50 of them along with a larger mothership. It is told as a case of officials seeing an organised fleet that no one could explain.
